generation.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c 0)) (grid-colors g)))
                  (counts (map (lambda (col)
                                 (let* ((mask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v col) 1 0)))
                                        (objs (objects mask 0)))
                                   (list col (length objs))))
                               colors))
                  (sorted-counts (reverse (sort-by counts (lambda (x) (second x)))))
                  (n (length sorted-counts))
                  (max-w (second (first sorted-counts))))
             (build-grid n
                         max-w
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((entry (nth sorted-counts r))
                                (col (first entry))
                                (cnt (second entry)))
                           (if (>= c (- max-w cnt)) col 0)))))))
